recipe.title: Cinnamon Whole Grain Power Pancakes
recipe.description: These Cinnamon Whole Grain Power Pancakes are so simple to make and will keep you full all morning.
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend for 30 seconds until the batter is mostly smooth. Preheat a griddle to medium high heat.

Pour about 1/4 cup pancake batter onto the hot griddle and cook for about three minutes or until bubbles form on top. Flip to the other side and cook for another 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a plate and serve topped with fruit, almond butter, chia seeds, and of course, maple syrup.
